name: Salesforce Transit Center
note: Pelli Clarke Pelli 2018, with PWP's Salesforce Park on the roof, the Mission Street gondola and the bridge from Salesforce Tower. Placed at a point with a size, not on its OSM footprint: way/542375290 carries layer=-1 and relation/8524888 level=3, and the bake drops both — there is no building and no park polygon in the package here. front 45 turns the model's +z (its front) to bearing 315, the Mission/Minna side, where the gondola and the bridge are.
